results.label: Map data and road graph
results.scope: OSM graph, import and provenance checks; no independently surveyed UK road law.

results.label: Road legality and restrictions
results.scope: Mapped one-way, access and turn restriction contract checks; legal truth provisional.

results.label: GPS positioning and road matching
results.scope: Map-derived position/heading/candidate tests; no independent real GNSS accuracy.

results.label: GPS signal loss and recovery
results.scope: Simulated invalid GPS, missed fixes and reacquisition; no phone/tunnel field proof.

results.label: Route computation and validity
results.scope: Actual local route search and frozen input validation tests.

results.label: Route quality and preferences
results.scope: Route length/time/cost and preference units, not independently optimal UK routes.

results.label: Route calculation speed
results.scope: Timing-worker test methodology and algorithm units; no comparable cross-engine latency ranking.

results.label: Junction turns and maneuvers
results.scope: Junction scorer and instruction contract tests; not road-truth verified.

results.label: Roundabout exits and paths
results.scope: Synthetic roundabout exit/instruction controls only.

results.label: Lane counts and next-turn guidance
results.scope: Actual UK lane arrows, combined turn/through and best-lane advice not executed.

results.label: Route line and turn-point road adherence
results.scope: Full route-line drift, roundabout arc clipping, wrong-side turn point untested.

results.label: Wrong turns and rerouting
results.scope: Rerouting controller state and wrong-turn policies; not full Android real drives.

results.label: Navigation instructions and timing
results.scope: No measured approach/at-turn/after-turn or adaptive spoken timing test.

results.label: Traffic, closures and dynamic replanning
results.scope: Live incident, closure and traffic response tests not executed.

results.label: Road section speed limits and alerts
results.scope: Speed-limit per-section, alert correctness and verified camera checks not executed.

results.label: Correct arrival and approach side
results.scope: Arrival state/controller units, not verified driveway/property approach.

results.label: Offline routing, maps and updates
results.scope: Host offline navigation package tests; Android downloads/updates not demonstrated.

results.label: Voice, Bluetooth and music ducking
results.scope: Android voice/Bluetooth music ducking not tested.

results.label: Failure handling, integrity and safety gates
results.scope: Evidence integrity and readiness gate tests, not full app resilience.

results.label: Memory, CPU, energy and map size
results.scope: Synthetic benchmark controls; no equivalent device CPU/RAM/battery measurements.

results.label: Complete press-navigate driving
results.scope: No end-to-end full UK map-replay with actual Android navigation.

results.label: Android emulator and app integration
results.scope: No Android emulator/device integration executed by this unit stage.

results.label: Competitor adapters and comparison integrity
results.scope: Adapter contract checks are not live external engine comparisons.
